headline: League Sits at 0.0-0.0 For Second Straight Week, Nobody Has Scored a Point in 2026
meme_brief: Twelve grown men in a fantasy league where literally nothing has happened for two weeks straight — every scoreboard reads 0.0 to 0.0, like the games are being played but the lights are off and nobody's told the players.
recap: For the second consecutive week, every game in the league finished 0.0 to 0.0. All six matchups — Chuba Bucky Doo versus Geoff Collins Suvivor, Joe Mama Angie Daddy versus Screaming Eagles, Broke Dak Mountain versus Pukachu Chews You, Waffle House versus mikelanta, Silverbacks versus demon44, and Meredith's Fan Club versus Dak's Stack — ended in a dead-even nothing. There is no closest game because they were all equally close. There is no blowout because a blowout requires a differential greater than zero. There is no top scorer because nobody scored.
transaction_desk: No moves were logged around the league this week — a quiet stretch on waivers across the board. The only items worth tracking are three adds still sitting from Week 1, and they're all still stuck at zero cumulative points through two weeks: Detroit's team defense on mikelanta's roster, Najee Harris on Broke Dak Mountain's bench, and Xavier Hutchinson also on Broke Dak Mountain. None of it cost waiver priority, so at least nobody burned anything for the privilege of watching a zero.

power_rankings.blurb: Undefeated, un-scored-upon, and commissioner-run — draw your own conclusions.

standings_narrative: Every team sits at 0-0 with identical points for and against, which makes discussing a playoff bubble technically impossible but structurally hilarious — six of these twelve teams are going to make it, and right now the tiebreaker could be a coin flip. Nobody has separated themselves, nobody has fallen behind, and the league is functioning as the most perfectly egalitarian fantasy football experience in recorded history. That will not last.
look_ahead: Week 3 brings a fresh slate: Chuba Bucky Doo draws Waffle House, Joe Mama Angie Daddy gets Meredith's Fan Club, Broke Dak Mountain faces Silverbacks, Geoff Collins Suvivor meets mikelanta, Dak's Stack takes on Screaming Eagles, and Pukachu Chews You squares off with demon44. Given the first two weeks of this league's data, the safest prediction anyone can make is that literally anything is possible, since apparently nothing is required to happen at all.

running_jokes: The Great Zero continues — two straight weeks, every single matchup in the league at 0.0-0.0, an unbroken streak of total offensive nonexistence.
Broke Dak Mountain's Week 1 adds (Najee Harris, Xavier Hutchinson) remain scoreless through two weeks, quietly the least productive stash in the league.
